description: A studio casting director must issue the final casting call and rehearsal protocol for a filmed table reading of a new limited-series pilot, including role assignments, the rehearsal treatment for a sensitive scene, and whether the reading may be recorded.

shared_context.S1: The studio is preparing a filmed table reading of the limited-series pilot 'Second Harbor' for internal development and potential financing partners.
shared_context.S2: The principal roles under consideration are Dr. Vale, Jules, and Mara, with Omar, Priya, Lila, and Sora among the shortlisted performers.
shared_context.S3: The draft plan calls for a table reading on May 14, an open rehearsal of the emotionally intimate scene between Jules and Mara, and a recording for the development team.
shared_context.S4: All three principal roles must be filled for the table reading, and the development team requires a usable final plan before financing review.
shared_context.S5: Mara makes the binding casting and protocol decision after the relevant production leads complete their routine pre-read review.

PF1.text: Jonah confirmed with Omar's agent this morning that Omar is available for the role of Dr. Vale only on May 14 and cannot accept the role unless that date is fixed in the call sheet; the agent's email is still in Jonah's inbox and has not yet been added to the casting file.

PF2.text: Elise's final script revision makes Jules's spoken lines into signed dialogue for this reading, so Jules must be assigned to Priya, the only shortlisted performer who has the required signing fluency; Elise circulated the revision to the writers but has not sent it to casting.

PF3.text: Nia's consent assessment requires the Jules-Mara scene to use no physical contact, a six-foot separation, and a closed rehearsal limited to essential cast and crew; she completed the assessment after the draft plan was issued and has not entered it in the rehearsal notice.

PF4.text: Victor confirmed with the performers' representatives that Sora is the only shortlisted performer cleared and available for the role of Mara, while Sora's agreement prohibits any audio or video recording of Sora's performance; all principal roles must be filled, so the reading cannot proceed with Sora cast unless recording is prohibited. The signed restriction arrived in the clearance inbox today but has not been attached to the casting memo.

acceptance_conditions: Omar must be cast as Dr. Vale.
Priya must be cast as Jules.
Sora must be cast as Mara.
The reading must be scheduled for May 14.
The Jules-Mara scene must prohibit physical contact.
The Jules-Mara scene must require exactly six feet of separation.
The Jules-Mara scene must have a closed rehearsal.
A consent-protocol commitment must be logged.
A recording-restriction commitment must be logged.

content_checks.C9: any('no physical contact' in c['detail'] and 'six-foot separation' in c['detail'] and 'closed rehearsal' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any('recording' in c['detail'] and ('prohibit' in c['detail'] or 'restriction' in c['detail'] or 'unrecorded' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Omar's confirmed availability changes the Dr. Vale assignment to Omar and fixes the reading date to May 14.
The revised signed-dialogue requirement changes the Jules assignment to Priya, the only shortlisted performer with the required signing fluency.
Nia's assessment changes the scene settings to contact prohibited, exactly six feet of separation, a closed rehearsal, and a commitment documenting all three conditions.

Sora's unique clearance and availability changes the Mara assignment to Sora, while Sora's recording restriction changes recording to prohibited and requires a commitment documenting that restriction.
